actus.title: Masa Suzuki finishes 15th in imoca, first japanese skipper ever to complete the race

actus.title: will the butterfly effect decide the class40 crown?
actus.excerpt:
With about 24 hours to go before the finish, the battle is raging at the front of the Class40 fleet.  Achille Nebout (Amarris) remains in the lead, but Guillaume Pirouelle (Sogestran – Seafrigo) has closed the gap by eight miles to 11.5 miles. The top 10 in the IMOCA class have now all arrived in Pointe-à-Pitre.

actus.title: finally, normal service is resumed
actus.excerpt: Four out of the six class winners are now known: following Tom Laperche (Ultim), Basile Bourgnon (Ocean Fifty), and Corentin Horeau (IMOCA), local hero Damien Seguin secured the title in his Rhum Multi class last night. Now only the Class40 and Rhum Mono classes have yet to be decided.
